name: GazeChat

permissions.desc: Connects to Beeper Desktop on your computer and opens the setup links shown in the app.
permissions.name: network

permissions.desc: Captures audio from the glasses microphone so you can dictate voice replies, which are transcribed and sent as messages.
permissions.name: g2-microphone

tagline: All your chats on your G2 — via your own Beeper
description:
GazeChat - the most feature-complete messenger on Even G2 supporting WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, iMessage, Messenger, Instagram, Discord, Slack and every Beeper network through a Beeper gateway you set up yourself.

- Unified inbox across all networks
- Reply by typing on your phone (live mirror) or dictating
- Voice messages: tap mic to record (live level meter), send as voice note or transcribe first
- Reactions via long-press, incl. removing your own
- Photo previews filling the message area
- Video preview: tap focused video to play grayscale loop with transport bar
- Voice-note playback: tap focused note to play/pause/replay
- Playback speed 0.5x-2.0x (menu, survives restarts)
- Draft sync between phone and glasses
- Focus highlight via scroll; group sender names; date tags; unread badges
- Low-priority and archived filters

Privacy: talks only to your own Beeper Desktop (direct or via your own gateway). No third-party servers. Open source: github.com/builtproper/gazechat
